theme_and_context.project_type: Hybrid Fullstack (Mobile Customer App + B2B Web Dashboards)
theme_and_context.vibe: Fast, Frictionless, Clean, Trustworthy, Premium Fintech.
theme_and_context.concept: Take cues from globalcharge.com — zero clutter, bold typography, extreme whitespace, minimal cards, hyper-focused conversion funnels. The EV charging process should feel as reliable and instantaneous as a modern banking transaction.
theme_and_context.modes: Full Light and Dark Mode required

typography.font_strategy: The Anti-Default Rule applies. No Inter for headings.
rules: Use IBM Plex Mono for wallet balances, live charging metrics (kWh, Voltage), and earnings.
Never center align paragraphs or lists. Left-align for frictionless reading.
Use tabular-nums class for any live updating data to prevent layout shift.

colors.strategy: Function over Decoration. Neutral tones dominate. Color is reserved exclusively for active states, signals (errors/success), and the primary charging action.
rules: Do NOT use generic gradients. Keep surfaces flat or slightly textured.
Use the charging accent color (Electric Green) for the active charging ring and 'Start Charging' CTA.
Borders must be subtle (10-20% opacity equivalent) to create structure without noise.

borders_and_radius.strategy: Cardless where possible. When cards are needed, use sharp or tight radius.

surfaces.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/80 border-b border-border/50 saturate-150. Use strictly for sticky mobile headers and bottom navs.
surfaces.dashboard_cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border, no heavy drop shadows. Hover states add a slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-sm.

mobile_customer_flow.spacing: Generous. p-6 or p-8 for containers.
mobile_customer_flow.structure: Sticky bottom action bars for 'Start Charging' and 'Add Money'. Keep the top clear for camera/QR scanner and essential status.
mobile_customer_flow.wallet: North-star metric layout. Huge balance at the top left, followed by quick-add chips.

b2b_dashboards.metrics_row: Top row spans 3 columns each. Focus on 'Today\'s Earnings' or 'Live Chargers'.
b2b_dashboards.tables: Edge-to-edge on mobile, tight padding on desktop. Strip away all unnecessary borders between rows.

live_charging_screen.concept: The command center. Must feel alive and responsive.
live_charging_screen.visuals: A massive, breathing circular progress ring (SVG or framer-motion) showing Battery %. Centered in the screen.
live_charging_screen.metrics: Surround the ring with grid items for Energy (kWh), Time elapsed, Current Power (kW), and Est. Cost.
live_charging_screen.action: A sticky, massive 'STOP CHARGING' button at the bottom. destructive color.

qr_scanner.visuals: Fullscreen camera view with a clean, 1px white framing box. A fallback 'Enter Code' minimal input field overlay.

forms_and_inputs.strategy: Floating labels or very clean left-aligned labels. Use Shadcn Input, but remove heavy ring offsets.
forms_and_inputs.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or sharp (rounded-sm) based on brand preference. Must have distinct hover/active scaling (scale-95).

toasts.position: top-center on mobile, bottom-right on desktop
toasts.usage: For charging started, stopped, wallet low, and fault alerts.

motion.micro_interactions: All buttons must have active:scale-95 and transition-transform. Use duration-200.
motion.page_transitions: Fade in with slight upward motion (translate-y-4 to 0, opacity 0 to 1).
motion.live_metrics: Use framer-motion to pulse the background of the charging ring softly (opacity 0.1 to 0.3).

media.strategy: Use high-quality imagery to break up the flat UI, primarily for profile avatars or generic station headers.

strict_rules: DO NOT use Inter, Roboto, Open Sans for headings. Use Outfit.
DO NOT make generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical or left-aligned structures to create visual tension.
DO NOT use heavy gradients on backgrounds. Stick to flat colors with subtle grain if needed.
DO NOT use the default Vercel/Stripe card look everywhere. Go cardless where possible with 1px structural borders.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='start-charging-button').
Use @phosphor-icons/react or lucide-react, but ensure consistent weight (1.5px stroke). No emojis for icons.
No transparent backgrounds for headers over content. Use glassmorphism strictly.
Provide instructions for .js files, NOT .tsx (project uses JS).
universal_guidelines.implementation_notes: Install required fonts via Google Fonts in index.css. Use Shadcn components but strip them of unnecessary padding and border-radius to match the stark fintech aesthetic. For the live charging ring, use an SVG with stroke-dasharray and framer-motion for smooth progress updates.
